extracted.intended_audience: researchers and grant-seekers interested in philanthropic funders; general public
extracted.subtask_description: A Wikipedia profile of the philanthropic organization Schmidt Sciences, summarizing its founding, stated purpose, major programs (AI2050 fellowship, AI safety research, ocean science partnerships) and recent investments in astronomy. Useful for understanding the funder's priorities and programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: funding unconventional research in science and technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Sciences' stated purpose is 'Funding unconventional research in science and technology.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization focuses on non-traditional, high-impact scientific and technological research; examples of supported programs include AI2050, Ocean Biogeochemistry Virtual Institute (OBVI), and AI science safety research.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI2050 academic fellowship thematic focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The AI2050 fellowship asks scholars to imagine a future in which AI has benefited society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schmidt Sciences committed $125 million to the AI2050 program over five years; prospective applicants should align proposals with optimistic, society-benefiting visions of AI and scholarly inquiry consistent with the program's theme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding for AI science safety research
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Sciences launched a $10 million venture to fund scientific research into safety problems in AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AI science safety program funded 27 projects (examples include risk mitigation technology and exploration of AI attacks). Projects addressing concrete AI safety challenges and scientific approaches to risk mitigation appear to be within scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for ocean science and biogeochemistry research
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Sciences partners with Schmidt Ocean Institute to support the Ocean Biogeochemistry Virtual Institute (OBVI) and has funded ocean science efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation's portfolio includes multi-million-dollar commitments to ocean science; proposals in ocean biogeochemistry and related marine science areas align with the organization's interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment in large-scale astronomical instrumentation and observatories
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Sciences announced funding for multiple astronomical projects (a private space telescope 'Lazuli', the Argus Array of telescopes, the Deep Synoptic Array radio telescope, and LFAST spectroscopy instrument).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization funds ambitious, infrastructure-scale astronomy projects focused on observational capabilities (e.g., telescopes and instruments for biosignature searches), suggesting openness to large, instrument-building initiatives.
